name: Platinum GSC
summary: **Platinum GSC** is a [[kind:cut|phenotype]] of [[gsc|GSC]] that rose to notice on the California cannabis scene in the early 2010s. It won first place in the Outdoor Indica category at the 2013 Santa Cruz Medicinal Cannabis Cup. Like [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint GSC]], it is generally cited as carrying GSC's [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[f1-durban|F1 Durban]] parentage.
